region.title: Region data
region.desc: The region picker uses the data shipped with the framework, including Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan (Taiwan stops at the province level; no sub-divisions are published). After administrative changes, sync a newer dataset from a source.
region.cardDesc: Syncing replaces the region list for all tenants; region codes stored in existing records are untouched.
region.sourceHint: Defaults to region.source_url in config.yaml; you can point it at a mirror here. HTTPS only, private networks are rejected. Content may be a flat code → name object or a three-level tree.
region.syncStarted: Sync started in the background — you'll be notified here when it finishes
region.syncRemoved: {{n}} regions no longer exist in the new data; existing records keep their codes
region.confirmReset: Restore the built-in data? The snapshot currently in use is stored as a new version first, so you can roll back to it from the version history.
region.resetDone: Built-in data restored (the previous snapshot was kept in the version history)
region.historyDesc: Before every sync, import, rollback or restore, the snapshot that was in use is stored as a version; the list shows the latest 50. A rollback re-validates that snapshot and writes it back: version numbers keep increasing and a rollback can itself be rolled back.
region.historyEmpty: No versions yet — the previous snapshot is stored on the first overwrite.
region.confirmRollback: Roll back to v{{version}}? The data currently in use is stored as a new version first, so you can come back to it.
region.rollbackDone: Rolled back to v{{version}}: {{added}} added, {{renamed}} renamed, {{removed}} removed
region.previewDesc: This sync will add {{added}}, rename {{renamed}} and remove {{removed}} entries; up to 20 samples per kind are listed. Nothing is applied yet.
